questions.question: When did Shoko start at Tokyo Jujutsu High?
questions.subject: Shoko Ieiri/Synopsis

answer.item: In 2005, she enrolled in Tokyo Jujutsu High as a first-year student along with Satoru Gojo and Suguru Geto.

questions.question: How did Shoko get her doctor's license?
questions.subject: Shoko Ieiri/Synopsis

answer.item: Shoko obtained her doctor's license by passing the national examination, although she faked the documents needed for exam eligibility.

questions.question: What did Shoko warn Gojo about keeping his Infinity constantly active?
questions.subject: Shoko Ieiri/Synopsis

answer.item: Shoko said that Gojo would fry his brain if he kept the technique always active

questions.question: Who took Geto's body after Gojo killed him?
questions.subject: Shoko Ieiri/Synopsis

answer.item: Kenjaku took advantage of this and stole Geto's body.

questions.question: Why did Gojo ask Shoko to keep Yuji officially dead?
questions.subject: Shoko Ieiri/Synopsis

answer.item: Gojo requested that Shoko keep Yuji's status as deceased to prevent the higher-ups from targeting him again

questions.question: What did Shoko tell Nanami about the transfigured humans?
questions.subject: Shoko Ieiri/Synopsis

answer.item: Shoko explained to Nanami that the transfigured humans could not be saved, and the best course of action was to kill them.

questions.question: How did Shoko confirm the dead sorcerers were Mahito's victims?
questions.subject: Shoko Ieiri/Synopsis

answer.item: Shoko then examined the dead sorcerers to confirm if they were indeed Mahito's victims for her report to Ijichi.

questions.question: Why did Nobara doubt Shoko could treat the students?
questions.subject: Shoko Ieiri/Synopsis

answer.item: Nobara questioned whether Shoko would be awake or even sober at the moment.

questions.question: Why did Shoko start smoking again during the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Shoko Ieiri/Synopsis

answer.item: she answered that she felt nostalgic about her student days

questions.question: How did Shoko help Hana Kurusu unseal Gojo?
questions.subject: Shoko Ieiri/Synopsis

answer.item: she along with Yuta Okkotsu treated Hana Kurusu's injuries so she could unseal Gojo from the Prison Realm

questions.question: How did Gojo's body reach Shoko after the battle?
questions.subject: Shoko Ieiri/Synopsis

answer.item: his corpse was teleported by Ui Ui to Shoko

questions.question: Did Shoko object to Yuta's plan to take over Gojo's body?
questions.subject: Shoko Ieiri/Synopsis

answer.item: despite Gojo being a close friend, Shoko did not object to his plan.
